SELECT pe.event_no AS eventNo, pe.event_type AS eventType, pe.payment_order_id AS paymentOrderId, pe.biz_no AS bizNo, standard_order.order_no AS standardOrderNo, pe.event_topic AS eventTopic, pe.downstream_system AS downstreamSystem, pe.publish_status AS publishStatus, pe.publish_status_type AS publishStatusType, pe.payment_success_http_stage AS paymentSuccessHttpStage, pe.retry_count AS retryCount, DATE_FORMAT(pe.last_published_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS lastPublishedAt, DATE_FORMAT(pe.next_retry_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS nextRetryAt, pe.last_republish_operator AS lastRepublishOperator, DATE_FORMAT(pe.last_republished_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS lastRepublishedAt, pe.event_payload AS eventPayload, DATE_FORMAT(pe.created_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS createdAt,
FROM t_payment_event pe LEFT JOIN t_order standard_order ON standard_order.order_no = pe.biz_no AND CHAR_LENGTH(standard_order.order_no) = CHAR_LENGTH(pe.biz_no) AND CAST(standard_order.order_no AS BINARY(256)) = CAST(pe.biz_no AS BINARY(256)) AND CHAR_LENGTH(pe.event_type) > CHAR_LENGTH('PAYMENT_') AND CAST(LEFT(pe.event_type, 8) AS BINARY(8)) = CAST('PAYMENT_' AS BINARY(8)) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM t_prepay_order pr WHERE pr.payment_order_id = pe.payment_order_id AND CHAR_LENGTH(pr.payment_order_id) = CHAR_LENGTH(pe.payment_order_id) AND CAST(pr.payment_order_id AS BINARY(256)) = CAST(pe.payment_order_id AS BINARY(256)) AND pr.order_no = pe.biz_no AND CHAR_LENGTH(pr.order_no) = CHAR_LENGTH(pe.biz_no) AND CAST(pr.order_no AS BINARY(256)) = CAST(pe.biz_no AS BINARY(256)) AND pr.source_kind = 'STANDARD_ORDER' AND CHAR_LENGTH(pr.source_kind) = CHAR_LENGTH('STANDARD_ORDER') AND CAST(pr.source_kind AS BINARY(16)) = CAST('STANDARD_ORDER' AS BINARY(16))) WHERE pe.event_no = #{eventNo} AND CHAR_LENGTH(pe.event_no) = CHAR_LENGTH(#{eventNo}) AND CAST(pe.event_no AS BINARY(256)) = CAST(#{eventNo} AS BINARY(256)) LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(1) AS totalEventCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS successEventCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS pendingEventCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS failedEventCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS deadLetterEventCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS unknownEventCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS failedOrDeadLetterCount, COUNT(DISTINCT downstream_system) AS distinctDownstreamCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS dueRetryEventCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN event_type = 'PAYMENT_SUCCESS' AND CHAR_LENGTH(event_type) = CHAR_LENGTH('PAYMENT_SUCCESS') AND CAST(event_type AS BINARY(64)) = CAST('PAYMENT_SUCCESS' AS BINARY(64)) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS paymentSuccessEventCount, DATE_FORMAT(MAX(last_published_at), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS latestPublishedAt FROM t_payment_event
